d:
Diljit Dosanjh hit back at the Cockroach Janata Party during his Delhi concert, saying Punjabis do not need to be taught how to fight. Following his remarks, CJP leader Abhijeet Dipke responded with a conciliatory note, expressing regret over their earlier disagreement and asking Diljit to forgive him and put the controversy to rest.
